meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查并修复 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 的安装健康状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果本地 LazyCodex 或 Codex 安装可能已过时或损坏
copy.tagline_en: Check and fix LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your local LazyCodex or Codex install may be stale or broken

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会检查本地 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 的安装，与最新源码对比，生成 PASS/WARN/FAIL 健康报告，并给出修复步骤。只诊断，不修改你的安装。
howto.when: 当你说“检查 LazyCodex 健康”等，或提到 LazyCodex、lazycodex-ai、omo-codex，或 Codex 在安装/更新后行为异常时触发。

say.text: 检查我的 LazyCodex 安装是否健康。
我更新 Codex 后行为怪怪的，帮我诊断。
say.note: 对比最新源码，定位漂移。

say.text: 审计 LazyCodex 与最新版是否一致。
say.note: 比较版本和配置，给出差异。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude will inspect your local LazyCodex and Codex CLI install, compare against the latest sources, and produce a PASS/WARN/FAIL health report with fix steps. It only diagnoses, never mutates your install.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a health check, mention LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or when Codex behaves oddly after an install/update.

say_en.text: Check if my LazyCodex install is healthy.
My Codex acts weird after an update, diagnose.
say_en.note: Compares to latest source, finds drift.

say_en.text: Audit my LazyCodex vs the latest version.
